description: Files directly in a module's application/ folder (backend.md section 3 rule 3: the last resort for shared application logic). Each entry is '<module>/application/<file>.ts' with a 'reason': the step of rule 3 that was tried and why it did not apply. A new file fails tests/architecture/api/pinned.test.ts until it is recorded here in the same pull request. The Epic aimed for an empty list; the remaining ones are run-lookup-requests, repository-cleanup and the read models shown whole by more than one feature, each with its reason below.

executions/application/run-lookup-reques.reason: Steps 1 to 5 tried: its steps are one transaction across two aggregates (the Run and its lookup), so they fit on neither one (1); no infrastructure capability is involved (2); the five entry points that request a lookup (refresh, failing checks, review comments, Follow-up refresh, daily refresh) do not share their other steps, so they are not one use case (3); the answer is needed at once, so it cannot be a job or event (4); the steps are too many to repeat (5).

executions/application/run-view.ts.reason: Steps 1 to 5 tried: a result shape is no behaviour of the entity (1); no infrastructure capability is involved (2); the single Run, the two Run lists, the failing-checks preparation and the pull request refresh all show the whole Run, and handlers never call each other, so no one use case holds it (3); it is no job or event (4); copying its fields into each of those features would drift, since a new field must be added to every copy (5). It is a type with a pure mapping from the entity: no rule, no repository or port call.

projects/application/repository-cleanup..reason: Steps 1 to 5 tried: it calls ports (Git, Deploy keys), so it cannot live in the domain (1); it is a sequence of several ports, not one infrastructure capability (2); the operator's Disconnect and the start-up resume differ in trigger and input, so they are not one use case (3); it cannot be a job or event, since the operator's Disconnect answers with the outcome (4); it is too long to repeat: three ordered steps, the record delete and the failure handling (5).

projects/application/project-view.ts.reason: Steps 1 to 5 tried: a result shape is no behaviour of the entity (1); no infrastructure capability is involved (2); create, list and get-project all show the Project, and handlers never call each other, so no one use case holds it (3); it is no job or event (4); copying its fields into each of those features would drift, since a new field must be added to every copy (5). It is a type with a pure mapping from the entity: no rule, no repository or port call.

projects/application/repository-view.ts.reason: Steps 1 to 5 tried: a result shape is no behaviour of the entity (1); no infrastructure capability is involved (2); connect, verify, fetch, disconnect and get-repository all show the Repository, and handlers never call each other, so no one use case holds it (3); it is no job or event (4); copying its fields into each of those features would drift, since a new field must be added to every copy (5). It is a type with a pure mapping from the entity: no rule, no repository or port call.

projects/application/environment-file-vi.reason: Steps 1 to 5 tried: a result shape is no behaviour of the entity (1); no infrastructure capability is involved (2); get and set show the same Environment file, and handlers never call each other, so no one use case holds it (3); it is no job or event (4); copying its fields into each of those features would drift, since a new field must be added to every copy (5). It is a type with a pure mapping from the entity: no rule, no repository or port call.
